summary_en: 1,000,000 shares (1.62% S/O ex-treasury), ¥2.3 billion upper limit, ¥2.3/share ceiling (implied), open-market purchase on TSE, Aug 7–Dec 31, 2026. Reason: flexible capital-allocation response to changing business environment.
title_en: Notice of Determination of Matters Relating to Acquisition of Treasury Stock
translation_en_brief: On 6 August 2026, SAN-AI OBBLI's board of directors authorized a treasury stock acquisition program under Companies Act Articles 156 and 165. The company will acquire up to 1,000,000 shares of its own common stock, representing 1.62% of shares outstanding (ex-treasury base of 61,888,936 shares), for a total expenditure not to exceed ¥2.3 billion. Acquisitions will occur via open-market purchase on the Tokyo Stock Exchange between 7 August 2026 and 31 December 2026. The stated rationale is to enable flexible capital-allocation decisions in response to evolving business conditions.
